label: Physiotherapie
description: Krankengymnastik, manuelle Therapie, Lymphdrainage und Massage, oft auf Rezept.

config.instructions: Be welcoming, concise and ask one question at a time. Ask whether the caller has a prescription (Rezept) and note it; never judge whether a treatment is right for them. Series of appointments are arranged by the team — take a callback for those.
